title: Application Infra. Platform Engineer
description:
**Position Purpose**
 End\-to\-end accountability to deliver secure and compliant infrastructure solutions leveraging Sandoz’s global multi\-cloud platforms, to enable the application platforms supporting specific domains. Integrate Service Delivery, Engineering, and Operations to provide reliable infrastructure that enables business solutions. The position collaborates with strategic business partners, architecture and security, to design fit for purpose infrastructure solutions and platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your responsibilities include, but not limited to**
* Technology \& Infrastructure accountable for project delivery and/or operations in the given business sub\-capability in a multi\-cloud hosting environment
* Partner with Functional IT domains for demand analysis, solution proposal/evaluation and infrastructure delivery
* Drive sustainable operations of systems and applications in scope (both Global and Local) ensuring their stability and integrity and meeting customer service levels.
* Create the detailed infra design to operate the application software/services on Cloud (AWS/Azure), virtualized Hosting platforms (converged and hyper converged platform)
* Ensure designs produced adhere to architectural roadmap and support the development, execution and operations of applications.
* Execute technology delivery strategy for business systems, platforms and processes for a particular Business domain / Function.
* Partner with business partners to ensure Technology Service/Solutions Delivery teams deliver products according to strategy with reuse across other areas.
* Ensure on time within budget compliant secure and quality delivery of portfolio for responsible function / service area.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
 Minimum 10\+years of experience in total.
   

  

* Ensure services solutions platforms products are fit for purpose and achieve the desired business value and impact
* Run efficient DevOps for platforms, products, or systems ensuring availability and optimal performance for responsible function / service area.
* Establish and follow governance structure for projects, operations, etc. with right stakeholder representation.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

 \#Sandoz

title: Network Operations Center - Shift Lead
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The NOC Shift Lead is responsible for leading a team of Network Engineers during a designated shift, managing Major Incidents, ensuring the smooth operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the organization's computer networks. This role involves both technical expertise and leadership skills.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 At Zelis, Network Operating Center (NOC) Shift Lead is a leadership role within the NOC responsible for overseeing the activities of a team of engineers during a specific shift. This role requires a combination of technical expertise in network operations, leadership skills, Incident Management and the ability to manage and respond to network incidents.
   

  

 The NOC Shift Lead is responsible for leading a team of Network Engineers during a designated shift, managing Major Incidents, ensuring the smooth operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the organization's computer networks. This role involves both technical expertise and leadership skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Working in 24/7 Operational support.
* Monitor network, server, and health infrastructure using tools like LogicMonitor, New relic.
* Network Service \& Protocols (DHCP, DNS, NTP, VPN \& Tunneling, QoS, Common Protocols)
* Good experience in Firewalls, IDS/IPS and Authentication, configuration \& troubleshooting of Router, Firewalls (Palo Alto), VPNs \& Switch, troubleshooting tools (ping, traceroute, netstat, Wireshark) and Access control.
* Respond to alerts and incidents, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate as needed.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for issue resolution and escalation.
* Assist in routine maintenance tasks such as patching, backups, and system checks.
* Windows Server Administration and troubleshooting.
* Perception of analyzing the workflow, issue or the cause of the problem.
* Manages firewalls, IDS/IPS, and endpoint protection systems is an added advantage.
* Mentors junior staff and enforces security best practices.
* Able to perform the Firewall, WLC, Switch and Meraki upgrades.
* Lead Incident Management activities, ensuring timely resolution and communication.
* Initiate bridge calls or war rooms to drive communication among stakeholders for timely incident resolution.
* Plan and coordinate the activities of the NOC team during the shift.
* Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members.
* Act as the point of contact for major incidents during the shift.
* Communicate effectively with management and other teams during incidents.
* Monitor network performance and respond to alerts as needed.
* Analyze incidents, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure that network issues are resolved within established SLAs.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, resolutions, and activities during the shift.
* Generate shift reports and provide updates to management and relevant stakeholders.
* Provide ongoing training to NOC Engineers to enhance their technical skills.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
* Collaborate with other NOC Shift Leads and teams to address cross\-functional issues.
* Participate in regular meetings to share insights and updates.
* Collaborate with Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Application Support, Service Management, and vendor teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on service availability and reducing MTTD, MTTA, and MTTR.
* Ensure compliance with security protocols and procedures.


**Qualifications**
* 5\-6 years of experience in relevant domain NOC
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate CCNA or CCNP
* Proven experience in network administration and incident response.
* Previous leadership or supervisory experience.
* Practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident, Change, Problem, and Major Incident Management processes.


**Skills**
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations and make informed decisions.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, log\-analysis, and ITSM platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, LogicMonitor, Jira Service Management, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong incident troubleshooting, prioritization, escalation, service restoration, alert correlation, and RCA support skills.
* Ability to communicate concise incident updates covering impact, actions taken, findings, ownership, next steps, and outstanding risks to both technical and operational stakeholders.
* Strong written documentation and knowledge\-transfer skills, including incident notes, shift handovers, SOPs, runbooks, Knowledge Base articles, and troubleshooting guides.
* Ability to identify opportunities for operational automation and continuous improvement, with strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and customer\-service skills.


 This role requires strong technical and operational skills, with the ability to independently monitor, triage, troubleshoot, escalate, document, and support restoration of network, server, infrastructure, and application incidents during assigned shifts.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Manager II
description:
**Overview**
 As a Manager \- II , you will work closely with key product and engineering stakeholders to implement integrated environments for a wide range of complex products at RealPage across teams . Included management of team, business uses to technical impact analysis and driving to implementation of these use cases through Infrastructure, Configuration as code and O rchestration based automation across on\-prem and Cloud H ybrid environments.
   

  

 Manager  should manage, mentor, coach \& deliver technical guidance and indus tr y best practi c es to a group of Infra automation engineers responsible for products of the large and complex environment.
   

  

 This position will report to the IT Director in India and functionally will work with a Sr. Director in US.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Overall 8 \- 10 years’ experience in IT with strong technical exposure on automation (IAC, CAC \& DevOps) .
* A passion for Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, DevOps, Automation and running highly resilient/automated system for Hybrid environments .
* Be able to work in USA late morning, early afternoon hours .
* Mandatory knowledge in tool stacks: Azure DevOPs , Ansible, Terraform tools, Packer, Kubernetes
* Have previous programming/development background (Python, Orchestration tools) .
* Compile KPIs and evangelize the adoption of best practices in relation to Integrated environment use cases across the organization .
* Embed into Integrated Environment projects use cases and on\-call rotations to keep your skills sharp and stay close to the operational workflows and issues .
* Promote a healthy and functional work environment .
* Maintain project and operational workload statistics .
* Provide a solid foundation for building and maintaining successful Hybrid Infrastructure automation teams.
* Utilize technical knowledge and experience with complex systems and performance to maintain and enhance the company’s platform .


**Detailed Description**
* This individual should enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment where adaptability and flexibility is key to their success.
* Implementation of industry recommended best practices and provide technical guidance and support with accountability.
* Work with a diverse  team, developing both the technical capabilities and leadership qualities of engineers and technicians.
* Manage system automation, upgrades, integration, automated provisioning process, rebuilds and other projects as required .
* Implement process improvements and inform best practices in  automation and operations.
* Working with senior management to propose, agree, and deliver IT service with defined Service Level Agreements.
* Establish systems monitoring capabilities to proactively address issues .
* Establish application/ systems patch management procedures .
* Develop strategic goals and objectives for quality improvements.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal .
* Systematic, disciplined, and analytical approach to problem solving and detail oriented .
* Strong analytical and reasoning skills; must be effective at summarizing and communicating complex information .
* Demonstrated professional maturity to handle confidential information .
* Self\-starter and able to work effectively in a deadline\-driven environment .
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously with only general direction and minimal supervision .
* Solid organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage time effectively to meet deadlines .


**Qualifications**
* 8\-10 Years with a minimum of architect experience .
* At least 5\+ years of work experience in Orchestration based automation for a team for Infrastructure and Configuration as Code .
* Proven track record of designing, building, optimizing , and maintaining infrastructure on a large scale .
* Preferred candidates with professional experience starting from a product developer role and transitioning to a Hybrid Infrastructure automation engineer .
* A passion for Automation/ DevOps and running highly resilient/automated systems.
* 2\+ Experience in On\-prem to cloud Migration of products .
* Strong understanding of SDLC , Linux and Windows environments .
* Detailed u nderstanding of DevOps Process \& Tools (Azure DevOps, GITHUB, Packer, Azure Cloud , Artifactory etc ) .
* Mandatory a utomation background ( Terraform, Python, P owershell , A nsible, Linux/W indows desired state configuration) .
* Basic project management skills.
* Ability to work overtime when necessary.
